questions.stem: What does a wave transfer from one place to another?
questions.explanation: A wave transfers energy from one place to another without transferring matter. The particles of the medium oscillate about their rest positions but do not travel with the wave.

questions.stem: Amplitude is defined as the maximum displacement from the rest position to which point on the wave?

options.text: From the rest position to a crest (or trough)
From one crest to the next crest
From one trough to the next trough

questions.explanation: Amplitude is the maximum displacement from the equilibrium (rest) position to a crest or to a trough. It is not measured from crest to trough, which would be twice the amplitude.
